newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Daily Variety - June 20.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Daily Variety - June 20.

text.p: The following stories appeared in Friday's Daily Variety:
* Actor Keanu Reeves is close to a deal to star in the Warner Bros sci-fi film, "Matrix," and is to be paid close to $10 million against 10 percent of the gross.
* Brillstein-Grey Entertainment has named senior vice-presidents of production Matthew Baer and Michael Siegel as joint heads of its motion picture division.
* NBC executives Harold Brook and Jerry Petry have been tapped to split the duties formerly handled by departing NBC Enterprises president John Agoglia.
* German pay-TV network Premiere has signed large pay TV output deals with 20th Century Fox and DreamWorks.
* The movie, "Rodgers & Hammerstein's Cinderella," is finally ready to start shooting on Monday and will be a keystone of ABC's "Wonderful World of Disney" series.
